name: Can I perform a ceiling leak assessment myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I perform a ceiling leak assessment myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can visually inspect your ceiling and attic for obvious signs of water, a comprehensive and accurate ceiling leak assessment is best performed by trained professionals. Identifying the precise source of a leak often requires expertise in roofing systems, flashing details, and knowledge of how water travels. A DIY assessment might misidentify the source, leading to ineffective repairs. Professional assessors have the experience to spot subtle indicators and potential secondary issues you might overlook, ensuring a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: While you can do a visual check, a professional assessment is recommended for accurate leak identification due to the complexity of roofing systems.
